entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: This sturdy-lookin' door's pretty promisin'.[n]Let's head inside!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We've secured our route... So, what[n]should we do now? Do you want to[n]head out for today?
entries.uk: Маршрут прокладено... То що[n]тепер? Хочеш на сьогодні[n]закінчити?

entries.en: There are still things to do.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yeah! Let's get the hell outta here before[n]Kamoshida finds us!
entries.uk: Ага! Забираймося звідси до біса,[n]доки Камосіда нас не знайшов!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I see. Then let's keep exploring a bit more.
